content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in San Antonio

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review the official prerequisites—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects, or equivalent alternatives. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your background against PMI's current criteria at no charge.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover all PMBOK® Guide domains. Your course completion certificate satisfies PMI's formal-education requirement and prepares you directly for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, including your training certificate and project-experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee through their portal. Allow time for PMI's review process before scheduling your test window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice exams, and instructor office hours—to reinforce course material. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center or online. Sit for the PMP exam with confidence backed by structured, live-instructor training.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew your certification. Pursue learning through PMI membership, additional courses, conferences, and on-the-job leadership. Granite PM Academy and PMI's resource library make ongoing development accessible and career-relevant.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
